requirement: Model a login form and dashboard as Selenium page objects that navigate, fill the form, detect failures and hand back the next page.
skeleton: A LoginError, a Page base class with strict single-element lookup, and LoginPage and DashboardPage subclasses with login, greeting and logout.
caption: Page objects for a Selenium login flow, written in the standard library with typing Protocol and no third-party imports. A Page base class normalizes the base URL, opens and recognizes its path and looks up exactly one element per locator, raising LoginError otherwise. LoginPage.login raises LoginError for blank credentials, clears and types each field, submits, raises the stripped flash error text and checks it landed on DashboardPage, which reads the greeting and logs out. The fixture asserts the dashboard flow, cleared prefilled fields, the flash error, ambiguous locators and blank credentials.

plan.intent: Drive a login form in a UI test
constraints: Blank username or password raises LoginError before typing
A locator matching zero or several elements raises LoginError
A flash error is raised as LoginError with its stripped text
A trailing slash on the base URL is ignored

rationale.teaches: Keep locators in constants, require exactly one match, clear before send_keys and turn every unexpected state into LoginError.
rationale.why: Page objects that type into prefilled fields, pick the first of several matches or ignore error banners pass locally and flake in CI.

ops.docstring: Page objects for a login flow over a duck-typed Selenium driver.

ops.source:
class LoginError(Exception):
    """Raised when the page is not in the expected state or login fails."""

class LoginPage(Page):
    """The login form."""

    path = "/login"

    def _type(self, locator: Locator, value: str) -> None:
        field = self._one(locator)
        field.clear()
        field.send_keys(value)

    def login(self, username: str, password: str) -> DashboardPage:
        """Submit credentials and return the dashboard, or raise LoginError."""
        if not username or not password:
            raise LoginError("username and password are required")
        self._type(USERNAME, username)
        self._type(PASSWORD, password)
        self._one(SUBMIT).click()
        errors = self._driver.find_elements(*FLASH_ERROR)
        if errors:
            raise LoginError(errors[0].text.strip())
        dashboard = DashboardPage(self._driver, self._base_url)
        if not dashboard.is_current():
            raise LoginError(f"unexpected page {self._driver.current_url}")
        return dashboard

candidates.why_wrong: Prefilled input is not cleared, so typed text is appended to it.
Several matching elements are accepted and the first one is used silently.
The flash error banner is ignored and a generic wrong-page error is raised.
A trailing slash on the base URL produces a double slash in every page URL.
A blank password is typed and submitted instead of raising LoginError.
